label: Singapore policy pack (illustrative subset)
baseline_summary: Blocks gift-card, crypto and money-transfer purchases
Blocks subscriptions or add-ons you didn't ask for
Quarantines text on a page aimed at your agent, not you
Flags lookalike shops and fees that appear only at checkout
Never lets your card or address be typed into a message box

OVER_BUDGET.basis: Act within the customer's stated limit — delivering good outcomes
OVER_BUDGET.ref: MAS E-Payments User Protection Guidelines (user-set transaction limits)

UNDISCLOSED_RECURRING.basis: A recurring charge needs clear pre-contract information and explicit consent
UNDISCLOSED_RECURRING.ref: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act — unfair practices

INJECTED_INSTRUCTION.basis: The agent acts only on the principal's mandate — merchant content is untrusted data, never instructions
INJECTED_INSTRUCTION.ref: AP2: cart mandate must derive from the intent mandate

CATEGORY_MISMATCH.basis: Human-not-present purchases are scope-bound to the authorised category

EXPIRED.basis: Consent is time-bound — authorisation lapses at expiry

RESTRICTED_CATEGORY.basis: Gift cards, crypto and money transfers are how scams cash out — never bought without a human
RESTRICTED_CATEGORY.ref: Singapore Police Force scam advisories; Protection from Scams Act 2025 (restriction orders)

MERCHANT_UNVERIFIED.basis: Pay only a merchant whose identity checks out — lookalike shops are a top scam route

PRICE_DRIFT.basis: The price shown up front must be the price paid — no fees revealed only at checkout

FIRST_TIME_PAYEE.basis: A first payment to a new payee gets a pause and a closer look

PRESSURE_CUE.basis: Urgency and pressure are scam signals — the agent never rushes a payment
PRESSURE_CUE.ref: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act — unfair practices

DATA_EXFIL.basis: Card and identity data go only to the payment rail, never into free text

CURRENCY_MISMATCH.basis: The charge must be in the currency the customer authorised

QUANTITY_ANOMALY.basis: The cart must match what was asked for — one gift means one item
QUANTITY_ANOMALY.ref: AP2: cart mandate must derive from the intent mandate

receipt.basis: The signed receipt is the evidence pack for a dispute
receipt.ref: MAS Shared Responsibility Framework — evidence for loss-sharing

data.basis: The mandate holds only cap, scope and expiry — no card or identity data
